title: 第十四章：战斗之美
content_zh:
浓烟冲天而起，火药燃烧产生臭味与毛发的焦糊味混在在一起，出现一股奇怪的味道，让苏晓的眉头紧皱。
视线被浓烟遮挡，让他无法判断那只巨虎的具体方位。
“吼~！！！”
愤怒的虎啸在浓烟内传来，听到虎啸后苏晓的注意力高度集中，但全身肌肉却处于松弛状态。
肌肉绷紧会导致动作迟缓，在战斗时会出现致命的破绽。
手中长刀自然下垂，刀尖抵着地面。
巨虎还没出现，藏身在浓烟内，但苏晓能感觉到，那只巨虎已经发现他。
丛林间吹过一股强风，那团升腾的浓烟被嘘嘘吹散。
就在此时，一道庞大的身影，夹带着些许青烟从浓烟内冲出，是那只巨虎。
出现在苏晓视线中的巨虎，已经没有原本那么威风凛凛，身上大片毛发被烧焦，焦糊的毛发紧贴在皮肤上隐约还有火星闪动。
那庞大的躯体也是伤痕累累，数不清的铁钉镶嵌在皮肉中。
最严重的伤势，是巨虎的一只眼睛，那只眼睛四周插满铁钉，黑红色液体从眼窝内流出。
发现巨虎的伤势后，苏晓嘴角露出笑意，这种伤势就算不死，战斗力至少下降九成，他的陷阱非常有效。
果然，人类才是自然界最危险的生物。
巨虎夹带着呼啸的风声向苏晓扑来，几步就冲到苏晓面前。
与巨虎这种庞然大物相比，苏晓还没对方的前腿高。
可不知为何，苏晓的心跳开始加速，这种庞大的对手让他有些兴奋。
没等巨虎冲上前来，苏晓猛蹬脚下地面，枯叶飞溅，他几步冲到巨虎面前，手中长刀斩向巨虎的前爪。
“噗嗤。”
鲜血飞溅，巨虎的前爪被斩出一道伤口，【斩龙闪】不愧是评分10的武器，居然毫不费力的破开巨虎外皮，深深斩入肌肉中。

巨虎痛吼一声，之前的爆炸伤导致它动作有些弛缓，大脑到现在还有些昏沉。
就在巨虎准备反击时，苏晓已经向一旁侧跳，刚好身处巨虎的左侧，也就是巨虎瞎眼后的盲区。
两只磨盘大的虎爪连续向前抓挠，探出的虎爪居然闪着金属的光泽，一旦苏晓被抓杀，绝对会付出惨痛的代价，还在巨虎没能伤到他分毫。
借此机会，苏晓挺身上前，双手紧握刀柄，又是一刀斩在虎爪上。
之所以选择斩击虎爪，苏晓也实属无奈，巨虎的高度至少有四米，想要攻击巨虎的喉咙或头部等要害部位非常困难。
有那两只虎爪的威胁，苏晓不敢贸然攻击巨虎的要害部位。
但这也没什么，距离支线任务的时限还有几小时，苏晓还有时间，但巨虎却不同。
这只是战斗一小会，附近的地面就被大片鲜血侵染，用不了多久，巨虎就会因失血过多而倒下，到时只能任由他宰割。
巨虎也发现了这一点，独眼仇恨盯着苏晓的同时，开始萌生退意。
野兽就是如此，在极度恶劣的情况时，大部分野兽都会选择逃跑，除非身后有幼崽需要保护。
趋利避害不仅是人类的天性，野兽也是如此，更何况这只巨虎的智商很高。
巨虎粗重的喘息着，利爪深深没入泥土中，随时准备逃走。
战斗已经进行到这种程度，苏晓怎么会让巨虎逃掉，他可能花费宝贵的时间去布置陷阱。
就在巨虎刚有退意时，苏晓手中的【斩龙闪】连续斩击，在巨虎身上留下几道血肉模糊的刀痕。
看着巨虎仅剩8%的血条，不出意外巨虎必死无疑。
在轮回乐园中，可没有血量低于10%就会狂化的情况，在血量低于10%后，任何生物都会非常虚弱。
不要说狂化，巨虎现在跑都跑不利落，攻击更是杂乱无章，一心想逃。
在巨虎第六次意图逃跑时，苏晓将手中长刀刺入巨虎的后腿中，之后双手紧握刀柄，猛的向外拖拽。
刀锋划过肌肉的声音很特别，紧握刀柄的苏晓，清晰感觉到肌肉被割裂时，传递到刀身的轻微抖动。
巨虎一声哀嚎，后腿上出现一道极深的伤口，在鲜血把伤口浸满之前，苏晓看到伤口内一根被割断的肉筋。

筋断了，就代表巨虎已经失去逃跑的机会，它今天死定了。
或许巨虎也发现了这一点，一改之前的模样，面朝苏晓不断发出威胁的咆哮声。
苏晓站在巨虎满前，赤膊的上身沾染了大片虎血。
鲜血那滑腻与温热的感觉，刺激了苏晓的凶性，让他在这一刻显的格外凶悍。
站在这房屋大小的凶兽前，苏晓在笑，笑的格外温和。
‘科尔波山的主人’雄霸科尔波山许多年，从来没畏惧过任何生物。
但在这一刻，这只巨兽却有些畏惧苏晓，因为这个正在微笑的人类，可能会夺走它的生命。
“吼~！”
一声带着些许怒意与恐惧的怒吼，传遍整座科尔波山。
苏晓脚步灵敏的冲向巨虎，不时还变换方位。
巨虎压低身体，看来是准备和苏晓拼命。
一只虎爪夹带着腥风袭向苏晓的面门，这一爪可谓是又快又急，这只巨虎居然隐藏了速度，在这垂死之际显露出来，准备给苏晓致命一击。
如果被这一爪拍中，就算苏晓侥幸不死也只能选择逃。
苏晓看起来有优势，其实不然，他与巨虎的实力差距太大，就算被他斩了十几刀，但巨虎头顶的血条仅减少了1%左右，根本无关痛痒，这1%还要算上巨虎正在快速失血。
可他如果正中巨虎一爪，那战斗可能就结束了。
这致命的一爪已经拍到面前，苏晓依然保持前冲之势，居然主动迎上前。
就在苏晓即将被虎爪拍中时，他的双腿岔开，成跪姿，身体重心放低，整个身体后仰。
带着浓重血腥味的虎爪，紧贴着苏晓的鼻尖划过，强风将他的碎发吹起。
双膝淌起地面的树叶，苏晓险之又险的躲过了虎爪。
单手拍击地面，苏晓鱼跃而起，他现在刚好处于巨虎头部下方，巨虎脆弱的喉咙暴露出来。

苏晓当然不会客气，直接就是一刀。
大片鲜血喷涌而出，苏晓全身浴血。
在苏晓与巨虎搏命时，远处一片灌木丛内躲着一道瘦小的身影，从体型上看是个小孩。
“好，好强。”
灌木丛耸动，小孩的头从灌木丛内探出，头顶的草帽上还顶着几片绿叶。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Thick smoke rose into the sky, and the smell of burning gunpowder mixed with the smell of burnt hair, creating a strange smell that made Su Xiao frown.
His vision was obscured by thick smoke, making it impossible for him to determine the specific location of the giant tiger.
"Roar~!!!"
The angry roar of the tiger came from the thick smoke. After hearing the roar of the tiger, Su Xiao's concentration was highly concentrated, but the muscles in his whole body were in a state of relaxation.
Tight muscles can lead to slow movements, which can lead to fatal flaws in combat.
The long knife in his hand drooped naturally, with the tip touching the ground.
The giant tiger hasn't appeared yet, hiding in the thick smoke, but Su Xiao can feel that the giant tiger has discovered him.
A strong wind blew through the jungle, and the rising smoke was blown away by hisses.
At this moment, a huge figure rushed out of the thick smoke with some green smoke, it was the giant tiger.
The giant tiger that appeared in Su Xiao's sight was no longer as majestic as before. Large areas of hair on its body were burnt, and the burnt hair clung to the skin with faint sparks flickering.
The huge body was also covered in scars, with countless iron nails embedded in the flesh.
The most serious injury was one of the giant tiger's eyes. That eye was surrounded by iron nails and black-red liquid flowed out of the eye socket.
After discovering the giant tiger's injury, Su Xiao smiled. Even if he survived this injury, his combat effectiveness would be reduced by at least 90%. His trap was very effective.
Sure enough, humans are the most dangerous creatures in nature.
The giant tiger rushed toward Su Xiao with the sound of howling wind, and rushed in front of Su Xiao in a few steps.
Compared with a behemoth like a giant tiger, Su Xiao was not as tall as the opponent's front legs.
But for some reason, Su Xiao's heartbeat began to accelerate. Such a huge opponent made him a little excited.
Before the giant tiger could rush forward, Su Xiao kicked the ground hard, causing dead leaves to fly. He rushed in front of the giant tiger in a few steps, and slashed at the giant tiger's front paws with the long knife in his hand.
"Pfft."
Blood spattered, and a wound was cut on the giant tiger's front paw. [Dragon Killing Flash] was indeed a 10-rated weapon. It broke through the giant tiger's skin effortlessly and cut deeply into the muscles.
The giant tiger roared in pain. The previous explosion injury caused its movements to become a little sluggish, and its brain was still a little dazed.
Just when the giant tiger was about to counterattack, Su Xiao had already jumped to the side and was just on the left side of the giant tiger, which was the blind spot behind the giant tiger's blindness.
The two tiger claws as big as millstones scratched forward continuously, and the protruding tiger claws shone with a metallic luster. Once Su Xiao was caught and killed, he would definitely pay a heavy price, and the giant tiger failed to hurt him at all.
Taking this opportunity, Su Xiao stepped forward, grasped the handle of the knife tightly with both hands, and slashed the tiger's claw with another knife.
The reason why Su Xiao chose to chop the tiger's claws was because the giant tiger was at least four meters tall. It was very difficult to attack the tiger's throat or head and other vital parts.
With the threat of those two tiger claws, Su Xiao did not dare to attack the giant tiger's vital parts rashly.
But it doesn't matter. There are still a few hours left before the time limit for the side mission. Su Xiao still has time, but the giant tiger is different.
It was only a short period of fighting, and the nearby ground was covered in large amounts of blood. It wouldn't take long for the giant tiger to fall down due to excessive blood loss, and he would have no choice but to be slaughtered by him.
Juhu also discovered this. While staring at Su Xiao with one eye of hatred, he began to think about retreating.
This is the case with wild beasts. In extremely bad situations, most wild beasts will choose to run away unless there are cubs behind them that need protection.
It is not only human nature to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages, but also animals, not to mention this giant tiger's high IQ.
The giant tiger panted heavily, its sharp claws sinking deeply into the soil, ready to escape at any moment.
The battle has progressed to this extent, how could Su Xiao let the giant tiger escape? He might have spent precious time setting up traps.
Just when the giant tiger was about to retreat, Su Xiao's [Dragon-Slaying Flash] struck continuously, leaving several bloody knife marks on the giant tiger's body.
Seeing that only 8% of the giant tiger is leftThe health bar indicates that the giant tiger will definitely die if nothing happens.
In the reincarnation paradise, there is no situation where the blood volume falls below 10% and it will go crazy. After the blood volume falls below 10%, any creature will be very weak.
Not to mention going crazy, the giant tiger is having trouble running now, and its attacks are even more chaotic, trying to escape.
When the giant tiger tried to escape for the sixth time, Su Xiao stabbed the long knife into the giant tiger's hind leg, then grasped the handle of the knife with both hands and dragged it fiercely outward.
The sound of the blade cutting across the muscles was very special. Su Xiao, who was holding the handle tightly, could clearly feel the slight vibration transmitted to the blade when the muscles were cut.
The giant tiger howled, and a deep wound appeared on its hind leg. Before the blood filled the wound, Su Xiao saw a severed tendon in the wound.
A broken tendon means that the giant tiger has lost the chance to escape, and it will die today.
Perhaps the giant tiger also discovered this, changed his previous appearance, and continued to roar threateningly towards Su Xiao.
Su Xiao stood in front of the giant tiger, her shirtless upper body stained with large amounts of tiger blood.
The smooth and warm feeling of the blood stimulated Su Xiao's ferocity, making him look particularly ferocious at this moment.
Standing in front of this house-sized beast, Su Xiao was smiling, and her smile was particularly gentle.
The 'Master of Mount Colpo' has dominated Mount Colpo for many years and has never been afraid of any creature.
But at this moment, this giant beast was a little afraid of Su Xiao, because this smiling human being might take away its life.
"Ho~!"
A roar with a bit of anger and fear spread throughout Mount Kolbo.
Su Xiao rushed towards the giant tiger with nimble steps, changing directions from time to time.
The giant tiger lowered his body, seemingly preparing to fight Su Xiao desperately.
A tiger claw carried a fishy wind and struck at Su Xiao's face. This claw was fast and urgent. This giant tiger actually hid its speed and revealed itself at the moment of death, preparing to give Su Xiao a fatal blow.
If he was hit by this claw, even if Su Xiao was lucky enough to survive, he would have no choice but to escape.
Su Xiao seemed to have an advantage, but in fact, the gap in strength between him and the giant tiger was too big. Even if he slashed him more than a dozen times, the health bar on the giant tiger's head only decreased by about 1%, which was insignificant. This 1% also included the giant tiger's rapid blood loss.
But if he hits the giant tiger's claw, the battle may be over.
This fatal claw had already been struck in front of him, but Su Xiao still kept moving forward and actually took the initiative to meet him.
Just when Su Xiao was about to be hit by the tiger's claws, he spread his legs and entered a kneeling position, lowered his center of gravity and leaned back.
The tiger claws with a strong smell of blood scratched close to the tip of Su Xiao's nose, and the strong wind blew up his broken hair.
The leaves on the ground were dripping from her knees, and Su Xiao narrowly avoided the tiger's claws.
Slapping the ground with one hand, Su Xiao jumped up. He was now just under the giant tiger's head, and the fragile throat of the giant tiger was exposed.
Of course, Lidya Su would not be polite and just stabbed him.
A large amount of blood spurted out, and Su Xiao's whole body was covered in blood.
While Su Xiao was fighting for his life with the giant tiger, a thin figure was hiding in a bush in the distance. Judging from his size, he was a child.
"Okay, so strong."
The bushes were trembling, and the child's head poked out from the bushes, with a few green leaves on the straw hat on his head.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
